title: FrogSlap — a look at my Android game developed with AI assistance
author: Remedion
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m working on FrogSlap, an Android game, and wanted to share its trailer.

AI has been part of the development process, including coding assistance with Codex and creating and refining visual assets. The workflow also involves Blender for sprite and animation work.

One of the biggest challenges has been keeping everything consistent. Getting a new asset is only part of the job: characters, backgrounds, animations and UI need to fit together. We’ve repeatedly compared new work against existing references, corrected mismatched details, and tested the results in the actual Android game.

I’d love some feedback on the trailer: does it make the gameplay clear, and what would you change in the opening seconds?

If you’re also using AI in game development, how do you keep the visual style consistent as your project grows?
